name: Hapatra, the Desert Frost
description: An Echoverse vizier who left Kefnet to his fate and now serves the undead monarchs of the high desert.

timeline.summary: Hapatra leaves Kefnet to his fate when he will not stand against Razaketh.
timeline.quote: Hapatra was a devoted follower of Kefnet, until she saw that he would not stand up against the demon Razaketh and left him to his fate.

relations.quote: Hapatra's command over the hearts of Amonkhet's people is far deadlier than any threat Samut has faced before.

pages_say.description: An Echoverse vizier who left Kefnet to his fate and now serves the undead monarchs of the high desert.
